podcast.body: A song from Isaac Hayes's 1971 album "Black Moses." The melodic elements and rhythms from this track are noted as sounding incredibly familiar to listeners because numerous hip-hop artists, and even contemporary acts such as Portishead, have utilized samples and instrumental bases from Isaac Hayes's recordings. "La canción Ike's rap 12 seguro que hay algunas partes melodicas y algunos rimos de este disco que os han sonado increíblemente familiares a vida artistas de hip hop que han usado bases e incluso artistas modernos como portis que han usado bases de estos discos de Lisa Kais."

srcs.episode: El RAP antes del RAP (los primeros años del rap)
